Subject: Resignation Notice  

Dear [Recipient Name],  

This letter serves as formal notice of my resignation from my position as Project Assistant at [Company Name], effective [Last Working Day, typically two weeks from the date of the letter]. My last working day will be [Last Working Day], in accordance with the terms of my employment contract and applicable labor laws in Switzerland.  

This decision was not made lightly, and I appreciate the opportunities I have had while working at [Company Name]. However, I have reevaluated my personal goals and aspirations, and I am committed to pursuing a new path that aligns with these priorities. Specifically, I have decided to resign from my position to dedicate myself to furthering my passion for surfing and establishing a surf school in Portugal. The proceeds from the sale of my flat in Zurich, amounting to CHF 180,000, will be invested in this venture.  

I am committed to ensuring a smooth transition during my notice period. I am fully prepared to complete any outstanding tasks, assist in the handover of my responsibilities, and provide any necessary documentation to support this process. Please let me know how best I can assist in facilitating this transition.  

I am grateful for the support and experience I have gained during my time with [Company Name]. I wish the company continued success in the future.  

Thank you for your understanding.  

Sincerely,  

[Your Signature]  
[Your Printed Name]  

Attachment: Copy of employment contract (if applicable) or any other relevant documents.
